metadata.title: Comprehensive National Indian Sign Language (ISL) Lexicon
metadata.authority: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC)
metadata.linguistic_system: Strictly Isolated Indian Sign Language (ISL, ISO 639-3: ins)
metadata.grammar_structure: Subject-Object-Verb (SOV) with non-manual markers and two-handed fingerspelling

categories.name: Greetings & Social Interaction
items: Two flat hands pressed together at chest with slight forward head bow
Open palms facing up sweeping inward toward chest
Flat hand fingertips touching chin and sweeping gracefully forward
Open flat palm rubbing in a circular motion on chest
Sign for GOOD followed by sun rising gesture with open hand
Sign for GOOD followed by sun setting / hands closing together
Signs for GOOD + MEET + YOU joined fluently
Open hand waving gently at chest or face level
Fist with thumb out rubbing in circular motion over heart with apologetic expression
Both hands clapping or raising with celebratory shaking palms

categories.name: Medical, Healthcare & Pain
items: Bent hand tapping radial pulse on wrist of non-dominant hand twice
Thumb tracing a small cross '+' on non-dominant arm shoulder
Index finger tracing a '+' red cross on upper forehead or arm
Thumb and index finger miming small pill taken to mouth
Index and thumb forming syringe pressed into upper arm or wrist
Clenched hand pressing firmly against left chest with grimace
Both index fingers pointing inward towards temples twisting with pained expression
Flat hand pressing on stomach moving in tight circles
Back of hand placed against forehead with shivering breath
Both hands clutching throat/chest with gasping open mouth
Index finger tracing spirals above head with wavering eye gaze
Hand wrapping around bicep squeezing like a pressure cuff
Both curved hands tracing revolving wheels at sides
Fist with beacon light rotating on top of head with urgency
Cupped hand over nose and mouth indicating oxygen mask
One hand wrapping around wrist or forearm

categories.name: Emergency, Safety & Alert
items: Both hands crossing sharply across chest in repeated urgent waves
Non-dominant flat palm carrying dominant thumbs-up hand upward
Both hands pushing outward sharply with alert facial expression
Index and thumb touching forehead rim forming police cap badge
Wiggling fingers flickering upward like rising flames
Patient has fallen / Down on floor
Two-finger person upside down on flat palm
Both hands held rigid shaking slightly
Both hands clutching neck in universal distress signal

categories.name: Questions & Inquiries (SOV Final)
items: Both open palms facing upward oscillating with furrowed brows
Where is it? / Where are you?
Index finger pointing upright wagging left and right with questioning gaze
Dominant index circling non-dominant index then touching tip
Index finger circling around mouth or chin
Touching forehead with flat hand pulling away into bent Y or open palm
Both curved hands back to back rolling outward and upward
Both thumbs upright dipping alternately left and right
How much? / What is the cost?
Fingers fluttering upward as if counting currency
Signs for YOU + HEALTH + GOOD/HOW with warm gaze

Hand placed beside tilted head resting on cheek like a pillow
'C' hand moving down center of chest to stomach
'C' hand near mouth blowing air across palm or wiping brow

Open palms patting chest upward with broad smile
Open hands drooping downward in front of face with downcast gaze
Both index fingers pointing towards site of pain with grimace
Index finger touching temple then shaking hand with furrowed brow
Both palms facing forward wiggling fingers in neutral space
Thumb-up sweeping upward and forward from chest

Thumb touching forehead or upper cheek / miming mustache
Both 'F' handshapes circling outward and touching fingertips
Hand patting downward as if measuring height of a child
Hooked index fingers interlocking with each other
Two hands supporting each other moving together

Touch chin/earring followed by SAME/SISTER hand clasp

Thumb and middle finger flicking away from chest with displeasure

Fingertips touching temple and flipping palm outward with shrug
Fist at forehead springing open into index finger with affirmative nod
Both index fingers pointing forward simultaneously in alignment

Both hands swinging away from body forward
